classification: descriptive drawdown-cluster attribution for the frozen R463 five-leg portfolio; train/validation defines weak-state thresholds; test/recent confirmation only; no promotion

weak_state.definition: T-1 regime score in the bottom third of the train+validation distribution OR T-1 breadth_above_ma20 below 35%

leg_contribution.method: daily rank z-score times 5-day forward return, cross-sectional equal-weight mean inside weak and non-weak days
leg_contribution.unit: rank/return covariance proxy, not portfolio PnL

known_limits: This is descriptive attribution and cannot promote R463.
Weak-state labels are based on lagged market-level data and are not a complete real-time vintage.
Leg contribution is a rank/return covariance proxy, not actual executed PnL attribution.
The test/recent windows have been observed before and are confirmation-only.
Current HS300 membership and industry classification retain survivorship bias.
5x cost is warning-only and never a hard rejection.
No leverage and no production activation.
